item.title: Sand.ai Launches Full MAGI-2 Video Model, With Open Weights Still Promised
item.description: The full MAGI-2 has 480B total parameters and supports longer audio-video generation, Sand.ai says. It is distinct from the smaller Preview, and open weights remain forthcoming.

item.title: NetEase and LiuGong Plan AI Excavator Production After Loading Demo
item.description: NetEase and LiuGong demonstrated a 922FE AI excavator and agreed to pursue production and exports. Broader operating figures concern NetEase’s existing loader fleet.

item.title: BAAI Unveils REAL Physical AI Assessment and HumanCOIN Data Plan
item.description: BAAI introduced a physical-AI assessment framework alongside embodied models and a staged HumanCOIN dataset release, not a full 12,500-hour download.

item.title: Ant Group Releases LingSante-Pulse Physiological Signal Encoder
item.description: LingSante-Pulse has public MIT-licensed encoder weights. Ant’s longer-term disease-risk claims describe downstream research, not an included diagnostic tool.

item.title: Amap Releases ABot-World 0.5 Iris Weights for Interactive Video
